title: EF Hutton Initiates Coverage of LQR House (LQR) with Buy Recommendation
body_markdown:
Fintel reports that on January 9, 2024, EF Hutton[initiated](https://fintel.io/sfo/us/lqr?utm_source=nasdaq.com&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=ef-hutton-initiates-coverage-of-lqr-house-lqr-with-buy-recommendation-778) coverage of LQR House ([NasdaqCM:LQR](https://fintel.io/s/us/lqr?utm_source=nasdaq.com&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=ef-hutton-initiates-coverage-of-lqr-house-lqr-with-buy-recommendation-778) ) with a **Buy** recommendation.


**Analyst Price Forecast Suggests 7,848.05% Upside**


As of December 16, 2023, the average one-year[price target](https://fintel.io/sfo/us/lqr?utm_source=nasdaq.com&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=ef-hutton-initiates-coverage-of-lqr-house-lqr-with-buy-recommendation-778) for LQR House is 306.00. The forecasts range from a low of 303.00 to a high of $315.00. The average price target represents an increase of 7,848.05% from its latest reported closing price of 3.85.


See our[leaderboard of companies](https://fintel.io/sfo/us?utm_source=nasdaq.com&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=ef-hutton-initiates-coverage-of-lqr-house-lqr-with-buy-recommendation-778) with the largest price target upside.


The projected annual revenue for LQR House is 36MM, an increase of 3,972.42%. The projected annual non-GAAP[EPS](https://fintel.io/seps/us/lqr?utm_source=nasdaq.com&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=ef-hutton-initiates-coverage-of-lqr-house-lqr-with-buy-recommendation-778) is -64.84.


**What are Other Shareholders Doing?**


Virtu Financial holds 105K shares representing 3.66% ownership of the company.


Citadel Advisors holds 70K shares representing 2.44% ownership of the company.


Hrt Financial holds 36K shares representing 1.27% ownership of the company.


Commonwealth Equity Services holds 17K shares representing 0.58% ownership of the company.


UBS Group holds 16K shares representing 0.55% ownership of the company.
